subject: Exploring a WASH Strategic Partnership with Jaldhaara Foundation | Tata Chemicals Limited
final_body:
Dear Head of CSR & Sustainability,

Jaldhaara Foundation has tracked Tata Chemicals Limited's notable CSR initiatives in safe water and community health. We specialize in deploying sustainable, community-owned water purification infrastructure.

In particular, we noted your impactful water initiative: "TCSRD safe drinking water projects covering 45 villages with installation of 12 community RO plants in Gujarat.".

We would welcome a brief 15-minute conversation to explore aligning our safe drinking water hubs with your CSR goals.

Could we schedule a call next week?

Partnerships Team
Jaldhaara Foundation
www.jaldhaara.org
